title: Build a paragraph sheet
subtitle: Collect grammar, vocabulary, and discourse observations in one place.
overview: A paragraph sheet prevents scattered observations. It lists finite verbs, clause markers, non-finite forms, key lexical decisions, and a translation draft beside the text.
The sheet is evidence for reading, not a substitute for reading. Each note should point back to an actual Greek form or construction.

sections.title: Paragraph-sheet fields
rows: Record lexical form and contextual sense.
Draft English and retain significant alternatives.
